description: UK State Pension for people living outside the UK: which gap years (2020–21 to 2026–27) can still be filled with voluntary National Insurance after the 6 April 2026 change, at Class 2 (£3.65/wk, years to 2025–26 only) or Class 3 (£18.40/wk), each year’s cost and 5 April deadline, the State Pension gain (1/35 of £241.30 a week per year, up to 35 years) with payback, the cost and years lost if you wait past 5 April 2027 (2027–28 rates £19.05/£3.80 as announced), and, with residence, whether it rises each year where you live and what NZ Super, the Australian Age Pension income test or Canadian GIS take back.

previousClass.description: If applied before 6 April 2026: the class being paid, 2 or 3 (Class 2 payers must also apply for 2026–27 Class 3 by 5 April 2027)

qualifyingYears.description: Qualifying years already on the UK National Insurance record

residence.description: Where the pension will be drawn: decides yearly increases and local deductions (NZ Super, Australian Age Pension income test, Canadian GIS)

ukContributionYears.description: Years of UK contributions paid in total

ukResidenceYears.description: Longest stretch living in the UK, years in a row

workedBeforeLeaving.description: Worked in the UK immediately before leaving
